lesson.title: Git Rebase and Resolving Merge Conflicts
lesson.goal: rebase a feature branch onto main with git and resolve the conflicts

sources.title: Git Rebase and Resolving Merge Conflicts

steps.title: Clone repo and check branches
steps.instructions: Clone https://github.com/philomatics/git-rebase-example (or init a repo where main and a feature branch edit the same file) and check out the feature branch. Run git branch -a to confirm you are on it.

targets.caption: Confirm you are checked out on the feature branch

explanations.topic: How git rebase moves commits onto a new base
Checking pushed branches with git branch -a
Why rebase pauses on conflicts commit by commit

hints: Which branch should be active before running git rebase main?
Use git checkout to switch to your feature branch, then list branches with git branch -a.
Run: git clone https://github.com/philomatics/git-rebase-example && cd git-rebase-example && git checkout feature/login && git branch -a
common_mistakes: Running git rebase while still checked out on main.
Rebasing commits that have already been pushed and pulled by teammates.
steps.run_command: git clone https://github.com/philomatics/git-rebase-example && cd git-rebase-example && git checkout feature/login && git branch -a

steps.title: Start rebasing onto main
steps.instructions: Run git rebase main to replay your feature commits onto main. When git pauses on a conflict, run git status to inspect the rebase state.

targets.caption: Identify which file caused the rebase to pause

hints: Which command replays your current branch commits onto main?
Run git rebase main and then inspect the paused state with git status.
common_mistakes: Running git rebase feature/login while already on feature/login.
Assuming the rebase failed permanently instead of checking git status.

steps.title: Resolve first conflict and continue
steps.instructions: Open the conflicted file (index.js in the tutorial), remove the <<<<<<<, ======= and >>>>>>> markers and keep the code you want. Stage it with git add and run git rebase --continue until it finishes.

targets.caption: Remove conflict markers and keep the desired code
Continue the rebase after staging resolved files

explanations.topic: How continuing a rebase differs from committing a merge

hints: Look for <<<<<<<, =======, and >>>>>>> markers inside index.js.
Save index.js, stage it with git add index.js, and avoid running git commit.
Run: git add index.js && git rebase --continue
common_mistakes: Running git commit instead of git rebase --continue after resolving conflicts.
Leaving conflict marker lines inside index.js.
Forgetting to run git add before running git rebase --continue.

steps.title: Confirm commit message in editor
steps.instructions: When Git opens Vim for the commit message, press Esc, type :wq, and press Enter to keep the existing message. Git applies the commit and moves on to the next one.

targets.caption: Write and quit Vim to keep the commit message

explanations.topic: Exiting Vim with :wq when editing commit messages
Changing the default Git editor to VS Code

hints: How do you save and exit Vim without changing the file?
Press Esc to enter Normal mode before typing any commands.
Type :wq and press Enter to save and quit Vim.
common_mistakes: Typing :wq while still in Insert mode instead of pressing Esc first.
Deleting all commit message lines, which aborts the commit.

steps.title: Resolve second conflict and finish
steps.instructions: Open the conflicted file (package.json), remove the conflict markers and keep the desired lines. Stage it, run git rebase --continue, save the message, then check git status.

precision_checks.label: No rebase in progress
precision_checks.command: test ! -d "$(git rev-parse --git-path rebase-merge)" && test ! -d "$(git rev-parse --git-path rebase-apply)"

targets.caption: Resolve the conflict inside package.json scripts
Confirm the rebase finished and the working tree is clean

explanations.topic: Non-conflicting commits apply automatically before the next conflict

hints: Check the terminal to see which file conflicted on the third commit.
Remove the conflict markers in package.json, stage it with git add package.json, and run git rebase --continue.
Save the commit message with :wq, then run git status to confirm a clean working tree.
common_mistakes: Stopping after the first conflict without finishing remaining commits in the rebase.
Leaving invalid JSON syntax such as a missing or extra comma in package.json.
steps.run_command: git add package.json && git rebase --continue && git status
